sents.zh: 两千多年以前，中国有很多小国。
sents.en: More than two thousand years ago, China had many small states.

sents.zh: 这些国常常打来打去，大家都过得不好。
sents.en: These states fought one another constantly, and life was hard for everyone.

sents.zh: 后来有一个人把它们都放在一起。
sents.en: Later one man brought them all together.

sents.zh: 他就是秦始皇，中国的第一个皇帝。
sents.en: He was Qin Shi Huang, China’s first emperor.
He did a great many things.

sents.zh: 他让所有的地方用一样的字。
sents.en: He made every place use the same characters.

sents.zh: 他也让大家用一样的钱。
sents.en: He made everyone use the same money.

sents.zh: 因为北边常常有人过来，所以他很不放心。
sents.en: Because people often came across from the north, he was uneasy.

sents.zh: 他决定在北边做一条很长很长的长城。
sents.en: He decided to build a very long wall in the north.

sents.zh: 很多人来做这个工作，一做就是很多年。
sents.en: Many people came to do this work, and it went on for many years.

sents.zh: 他们把土和木头一块一块地放上去。
sents.en: They laid the earth and timber up piece by piece.

sents.zh: 虽然工作又累又难，但是他们没有停。
sents.en: Although the work was tiring and hard, they did not stop.

sents.zh: 长城在山上走，看不到头。
sents.en: The wall runs along the mountains, with no end in sight.

sents.zh: 因为它非常长，所以叫万里长城。
sents.en: Because it is so long, it is called the Ten-Thousand-Li Great Wall.

sents.zh: 过去了两千多年，今天我们还可以去看它。
sents.en: More than two thousand years have passed, and we can still go and see it.
